subject: MSA + Order Form intake: governance, jurisdiction & signer path questions
messages:
From: Anna Sato <anna.sato@auroraai.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai; kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@auroraai.com
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora MSA draft + intake questions

Hi Markus / Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick turn here. Attached is our latest MSA (v3) and a short packet from procurement that outlines our standard governance and indemnity expectations. A few items we want to flag up front so we can avoid back-and-forth later: 

- Governing law: our standard is Delaware; Aurora prefers CA for certain subsidiaries.
- Termination for convenience: procurement expects a 60-day mutual termination right; our legal team prefers 30 days.
- Data return / deletion: we require a 90-day certified deletion clause for production data in the event of termination.
- Exhibits: we need Exhibit B (IP mapping) completed by the vendor.

Can you confirm who on your side will own Exhibit B and the SOC2 evidence? Also please send your preferred signer matrix (name, title, email) so procurement can build the DocuSign envelope.

Attachments: Aurora_MSA_draft_v3.docx; Evidence_SOC2.pdf

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Sato | Senior Counsel, Aurora AI
anna.sato@auroraai.com

From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Sato <anna.sato@auroraai.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai; priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora MSA draft + intake questions

Anna — thanks for the MSA and the heads-up. We've looped in Kimberly (legal ops / contracting) and Priyom (sales lead for Aurora) to handle the intake and signer path. Quick answers below, and I've attached our intake template for Exhibit B to speed completion.

- Governing law: we can accept Delaware for the Aurora entity signing the agreement. If a CA parent is a signer, we may need a short carve for tax/revenue reporting — Kimberly will confirm.
- Termination: Redwood's standard is 30 days mutual for convenience; we can be flexible to 60 days at the enterprise tier if there is reciprocal liability adjustment.
- Data deletion: 90-day certified deletion is acceptable for production data; we'll add the standard audit step for certificate issuance.
- Exhibit B (IP mapping): Priyom will coordinate the technical owner; Kimberly will review the completed exhibit before countersignature.

Next steps/action items: 
1) Kimberly to confirm final carve language on jurisdiction/tax.
2) Priyom to provide the vendor-side contact for Exhibit B (technical liaison) and billing contact.
3) I'll prepare a short summary memo for procurement explaining how termination and liability trade with the enterprise discount.

Attachments: redline_template.xlsx (intake template for Exhibits)

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Sato <anna.sato@auroraai.com>; markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai; procurement@auroraai.com
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora MSA draft + intake questions

Thanks — a few clarifications and a proposed small edit below. I also included a short checklist we use for SOC2/technical evidence handoff.

1) Jurisdiction carve: we propose the following sentence to be added to Section 20 (Governing Law) when the signer is a CA parent entity to avoid dual tax/residency disputes: 

"Notwithstanding the foregoing, to the extent any tax or revenue reporting obligation arises solely as a result of the physical presence of a parent entity in the State of California, the parties agree to negotiate in good faith a limited administrative carve-out to address tax reporting only, without expanding substantive contractual remedies."

2) Termination: the 60-day mutual termination is acceptable if Aurora agrees to limit the post-termination liability cap to 12 months of fees for termination-without-cause scenarios. That preserves economics for both sides.

3) Exhibit B: please have your technical liaison complete columns A-D of the attached template. We'll validate the IP ownership assertions and mark any integrations requiring data-processor statements.

SOC2/evidence checklist (for procurement):
- SOC2 Type II latest report (most recent 12 months) — included
- List of subprocessors with contact info — expected within 5 business days
- Data retention and deletion flow diagram — requested

Anna — if you can provide the technical contact and the procurement billing contact, Priyom and I will populate the signer matrix and push the DocuSign. If procurement prefers, we can prepare a redline with the jurisdiction carve and the 12-month cap to show precise language.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Legal Ops | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Sato <anna.sato@auroraai.com>; kimberly_park@redwood.ai; markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@auroraai.com
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2027 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora MSA draft + intake questions

Anna — quick note from the commercial side. Our billing contact is billing@redwood.ai (Sarah Meyers, Billing Manager). For the technical liaison to complete Exhibit B, please reach out to: tech-contacts@auroraai.com, attention: Rajesh Iyer (raj.iyer@auroraai.com).

We are happy to proceed with the jurisdiction carve Kimberly proposed and will accept a 12-month post-termination liability cap in exchange for the 60-day termination window. If Aurora would like us to prepare a tracked redline showing the jurisdiction carve and the cap, say the word and Kimberly will circulate it by EOD Monday.

Action items recap:
- Aurora: provide completed Exhibit B (columns A-D) and confirm Rajesh as technical liaison.
- Aurora procurement: confirm DocuSign signer names/emails for the Aurora signing entity.
- Redwood: Kimberly to circulate redline (jurisdiction carve + liability cap) by EOD Monday if requested.

Thanks — looking forward to progressing this week.
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
